summary: Start of an example of gathered Ansible facts in JSON: ansible_all_ipv4_addresses, ansible_apparmor, ansible_architecture, BIOS date and version, ansible_cmdline, ansible_date_time fields (date, epoch, iso8601, tz, weekday) and ansible_default_ipv4 (address, interface, gateway, mtu).
questions: What facts does Ansible gather about the default IPv4 interface?
How do I get the epoch time from facts?
